name: compass-components-catalog
description: Static discovery catalog for the Compass Components registry.

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.config.mjs && node scripts/generate-catalog-routes.mjs && node scripts/verify-catalog-build.mjs
scripts.test: python tests/validate_package.py && node --test tests/catalog.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/cli-bin.test.mjs tests/orchestration.test.mjs
